timeline_highlights.title: Ukrainian Drone Strike Causes Major Fire at Saint Petersburg Warehouse
timeline_highlights.summary: A Ukrainian drone strike ignited a significant fire at a Wildberries warehouse near Saint Petersburg on July 24. The blaze produced thick smoke that spread across the city and led to temporary disruptions at Pulkovo Airport, as reported by Russian authorities.

timeline_highlights.title: Yemen Government Forces Regain Control Near Bab el-Mandeb Strait
timeline_highlights.summary: Forces loyal to the Yemeni government have recaptured several strategic areas around the Bab el-Mandeb Strait from Houthi rebels. The operation, supported by the Saudi-led coalition, included the retaking of the town of Dhubab and other locations in the vicinity. This offensive aims to reclaim all territory held by the Iran-backed Houthis.

timeline_highlights.title: Over 200,000 Displaced Amid Renewed Fighting in Yemen, UN Reports
timeline_highlights.summary: The United Nations reports that more than 200,000 people have been displaced in Yemen due to escalating fighting between Houthi rebels and Saudi-backed government forces. The conflict has intensified in recent weeks, with thousands fleeing to Djibouti. The UN also warns that a significant portion of families in affected areas face hunger.

timeline_highlights.title: Russian Strike on Kramatorsk Buses Results in Significant Civilian Casualties
timeline_highlights.summary: A Russian attack on civilian buses in the eastern Ukrainian city of Kramatorsk has resulted in at least 30 to 33 fatalities, with many others wounded. The strike is part of a broader pattern of increasing assaults on civilian targets in Ukraine, raising concerns about the safety of non-combatants. Authorities have suspended public transport in the area following the incident.
key_facts: At least 30 to 33 people killed in Kramatorsk due to a Russian strike on civilian buses.
The attack is seen as part of a growing trend of Russian assaults on civilian infrastructure.
Public transport has been suspended in Kramatorsk following the attack.
